title: Exchanging Hearts
next_chapter_hook: When the words 'After breaking the heavens, will you take me away?' fell softly, Chen Ji realized his answer had perhaps been written long ago in the mists of the Tianji Record.

text.content:
A waning moon hung like a hook from the broken eaves of the ruined temple.

Chen Ji sat against a cracked stone pillar, his fingers brushing his sleeve where the Tianji Record Fragment concealed within grew faintly warm, as if reminding him of the pursuit arriving in three hours. His gaze fell upon Ye Qing nearby—the blood-red sleeve catching the moonlight was especially striking.

dialogue.content: 'Calculating again?' Ye Qing's voice carried a trace of exhaustion as she tucked the blood-colored token into her sleeve. 'Every time you use the Tianji Record, your Heavenly Fate decreases. How many more times can you endure?'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze shifted from Ye Qing's face to the pitch-black night beyond the ruined temple. The three major sects vying for power, the Demonic Path invasion, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land—the chess game of chaos had already been in play for far too long.

dialogue.content: 'Do you know,' Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice unusually calm, 'before the Tianji Record chose me, I spent an entire three years sweeping fallen leaves at the Tianqing Sect.'

text.content: Ye Qing was slightly taken aback. She gazed at this man who calculated every move, finding it hard to imagine he had once lived such a humble existence. Outside the ruined temple, several night owl cries added to the desolation of the silence.

dialogue.content: 'The first year, all the senior brothers stepped over me for entertainment. The second year, my master said in front of everyone that I wasn't even worth a废物.' Chen Ji's voice held no inflection, as if narrating someone else's story, 'The third year... I learned to smile.'

text.content: Ye Qing's fingers unconsciously tightened on her clothing corner. She suddenly remembered being seven years old, when Holy Sect disciples took her from her mother's arms, the desperate pleading in her mother's eyes.

dialogue.content: 'I too was once someone stepped upon.' Ye Qing's voice was soft. 'At the Holy Sect, those without value... even breathing is a luxury.' She raised her head, and on that妖异的 face illuminated by moonlight, there was unexpectedly a trace of vulnerability.

text.content: Chen Ji looked at her. In this moment, he suddenly realized—this woman called the Demonic Path Saintess—was so similar to him. Both were lonely souls forced to grow by fate, both learned to disguise themselves in darkness.

dialogue.content: 'So you understand now?' A slight curve formed at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth—a smile devoid of any calculation. 'We were never standing here together because of interests from the start.'

text.content: Ye Qing stared at him blankly. The Holy Sect had taught her that everything was a transaction, that interest was the only bond. But this man was tearing open all her defenses in a way she had never witnessed.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing remained silent for a long while before finally asking softly, 'Then why are you willing to tell me these things?'

choices.description: Honestly admitting inner exhaustion, wanting to shed the disguise
choices.risk_hint: Might be seen as weakness by the other party

dialogue.content: 'Because I'm tired.' Chen Ji closed his eyes, his voice carrying a trace of exhaustion even he hadn't noticed. 'I've been calculating for too long, sometimes... I really want someone who understands.'

Ye Qing's eyes reddened slightly. She suddenly understood why Chen Ji was willing to cooperate with her—not just because her 'Demonic Path Mists' could conceal the Tianji Record's aura, but because... they were both people backed into a corner by fate.

choices.description: Directly expressing recognition and respect for Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Deepening the emotional bond with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: May come across as too straightforward

dialogue.content: 'Because you're worth it.' Chen Ji stared directly into her eyes. 'When everyone else treated me as废物, you chose to believe in me.'
Ye Qing's breath hitched. People at the Holy Sect never told her 'worth it,' only 'useful' or 'useless.' And this man...

choices.description: Using Tianji Record's foresight to prove trust in Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Showcasing the unique bond between the two
choices.risk_hint: Exposing some details of the Tianji Record's abilities

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then said softly, 'Because I've looked with the Tianji Record. In all the futures... you never betrayed me.'
Ye Qing froze. She knew that every use of the Tianji Record consumed precious Heavenly Fate—yet Chen Ji had actually used it on her?

text.content: A rustling sound suddenly came from outside the ruined temple. Both tensed simultaneously. But moments later they discovered it was only a wild cat passing by, not pursuers. This brief peace seemed so precious in the chaos.

dialogue.content: 'When I was seven, my mother was killed on the spot to protect me.' Ye Qing's voice was soft yet carried a kind of经历过沧桑的平静. 'After that, I never cried again.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He simply listened quietly. This was the first time since becoming a strategist that he felt 'listening' was more important than 'speaking.' The night wind blew through the temple's cracks, carrying the chill of early winter.

dialogue.content: 'I once had a younger sister too.' Chen Ji suddenly said, his voice carrying a faint tremor he tried to conceal. 'Her name was Chen Nian... taken away by the Holy Sect.'

text.content: Ye Qing's body stiffened slightly. She knew about the Holy Sect's internal 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' plan—an taboo experiment using children as sacrifices. If Chen Nian had been selected...

dialogue.content: 'I will help you find her.' Ye Qing's voice suddenly became firm. 'If the Holy Sect is truly conducting that plan... I know the inside details better than anyone.'

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head and looked at the Demonic Path Saintess despised by the world. He suddenly discovered that in the chess game of this chaotic era, he was no longer alone.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing stood up and walked toward Chen Ji. At this moment, she wanted to...

choices.description: Without any ulterior motive, just simple reliance
choices.visible_reward: Two lonely hearts finally finding each other
choices.risk_hint: Breaking the subtle balance between them

dialogue.content: Ye Qing walked to where he stood, slowly knelt down, and then—gently rested her head on his shoulder. 'Let me lean on you for a while.' Her voice carried a tremor. 'Just for a while.'

text.content: Chen Ji froze. He had calculated countless possibilities, yet this one had never occurred to him. The faint fragrance from Ye Qing reached his nose, and his hand hovered mid-air, uncertain where to place it.

choices.description: Express support and companionship in the simplest way

dialogue.content: Ye Qing extended her hand and gently grasped Chen Ji's. Her fingers were cold yet carried a silent firmness. 'I'm here,' she said.

text.content: Chen Ji felt the warmth of that hand. He discovered that his tense nerves were gradually relaxing. How many years had it been? He had grown accustomed to bearing everything alone.

choices.description: Choose a more reserved approach, expressing through presence itself
choices.risk_hint: May make Ye Qing misunderstand as rejection

dialogue.content: Ye Qing did not draw closer, only sitting down beside him. Moonlight poured through the broken roof, stretching their two shadows long and overlapping them together.

text.content: Chen Ji glanced at her, the corner of his mouth slightly lifting. Though there were no words, in this moment, the understanding between them needed no words to prove.

Moonlight flowed like water, falling upon two lonely souls. They both knew the Holy Sect's pursuers would not stop, the heavens' chess game would continue. But at this moment, in this dilapidated temple, they had found each other.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji.' Ye Qing suddenly softly called his name, her voice carrying a tenderness unfamiliar to herself. 'After breaking the heavens... will you take me away?'

text.content:
This sentence was light as a feather yet landed heavily on Chen Ji's heart. He looked at Ye Qing's expectant gaze and suddenly discovered—in the Tianji Record, he had never seen this answer.

Perhaps some futures... lie beyond heavenly secrets.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji answer this question from Ye Qing?

choices.description: Making a promise about the future
choices.visible_reward: Making a生死 pact with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Would the heavens allow such a future to exist?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji extended his hand and gently grasped Ye Qing's. 'I promise you.' His voice was soft yet carried undeniable firmness. 'No matter how the heavens change, I will take you away.'
Ye Qing's eyes reddened. Since childhood, no one had ever made her such a promise. She gripped Chen Ji's hand back, her fingertips trembling slightly.

choices.description: Responding pragmatically, emphasizing that the present matters more than the future
choices.risk_hint: May make Ye Qing feel disappointed

dialogue.content: 'First survive.' Chen Ji said softly. 'When we truly break the heavens, I will answer this question for you.' His eyes flickered with a hint of cunning. 'By then, don't you regret it.'
Ye Qing was first stunned, then the corner of her mouth slightly curved upward. She caught the subtext in Chen Ji's words—this was not a rejection, but... another form of promise.

choices.text: Silence, only pull her into his embrace
choices.description: Using action instead of words, leaving the deepest imprint on this moment
choices.visible_reward: Two lonely hearts thoroughly blending at this moment
choices.risk_hint: An overly emotional gesture may not fit Chen Ji's usual image

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He simply gently pulled Ye Qing into his embrace. This embrace carried no ulterior motives, no calculating成分—merely one lonely soul's response to another lonely soul.

text.content: Ye Qing's body first stiffened, then slowly relaxed. She closed her eyes, allowing tears to slip from the corners. At this moment, she was no longer the Demonic Path Saintess, no longer a chess piece of the Holy Sect—just a woman longing for warmth.

The night wind gradually calmed, and the moon peeked out from behind the clouds, casting soft silver light throughout this dilapidated temple. Chen Ji felt the woman in his arms had fallen into a deep sleep, her breathing even and steady.

He did not push her away, only quietly maintaining this position. In three hours, the Holy Sect's pursuers would arrive; the heavens' chess game continued; Chen Nian still waited somewhere unknown for rescue. But for now, he only wanted this moment to linger a little longer.

The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve faintly burned, seemingly reminding him of fate's weight. But Chen Ji discovered that when Ye Qing was by his side, that burning sensation seemed not so unbearable after all.

dialogue.content:
'I will find Chen Nian.' Chen Ji said softly, his voice audible only to himself. 'Then... I will take you both away.'

Under the moonlight, his gaze was more determined than ever.
